text:
kelly-cs: Marigold AI requested UK region turned on + a temporary QPS bump for a product launch tomorrow morning. They also need our public IPs whitelisted on their proxy. Can infra help enable region peering and a time-limited rate increase?

sam-infra: Copy. Need CIDR(s) and exact window. Also, are they fine with hosted nodes in eu-west-2 (London) or do they want Dedicated?

kelly-cs: They want hosted (no Dedicated). CIDR: 203.0.113.0/24. Window: 2024-06-10 06:00-2024-06-13 06:00 UTC. Target bump from 100 qps -> 800 qps for the window. Auto-revoke after the window.

javier-eng: Hosted nodes in eu-west-2 can cover 800 qps but we'll need to ensure prefix cache warmup and autoscaling policy set to aggressive for the window. I'll add a temporary policy and a canary route to avoid serving from overloaded replicas.

sam-infra: Thanks. I'll open a quick infra change ticket and schedule peering. ops-bot: created CHG-48291 for region-peering and IP allowlist.

ops-bot: CHG-48291: eu-west-2 peering, add 203.0.113.0/24 to customer allowlist, temporary rate-limit increase to 800 qps (2024-06-10 06:00 -> 2024-06-13 06:00 UTC), auto-revoke enabled. Assigned to sam-infra, javier-eng.

mina-am: Heads up — Marigold is on a renewal review next week. They flagged latency in EU last quarter; this launch is critical to the renewal conversation. Please add a post-mortem checklist and SLA notes to the ticket.

kelly-cs: Noted. I'll capture launch metrics and share with AM after. Also, customer asked about SNI for their proxy. Is there a config we need to add?

javier-eng: We support SNI. For hosted endpoints they should call host: api.redwood.ai and SNI will match automatically. If their proxy terminates TLS and forwards, tell them to preserve TLS to our edge or add our public cert thumbprint. Quick example:

```
# if proxy forwards TLS, preserve client TLS
curl -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

javier-eng: If they must terminate, send the cert thumbprint to sam-infra.

sam-infra: Preparing peering & announcing IPs. Will share a short list of three public IPs to whitelist in the next 20m. Also will set autoscale min replicas to 3 for the window.

kelly-cs: Customer ops confirmed whitebox test tomorrow at 06:15 UTC. Please set a small warmup test (10 concurrent requests) 10 minutes before launch.

javier-eng: Will do. Added a small warmup lambda and pre-warm script to CHG-48291. Warmup steps: 10 reqs @ 06:00, 50 reqs @ 06:05, then full ramp.

ops-bot: CHG-48291 updated: warmup steps added, autoscale policy updated, whitelist staged.

alex-sales: FYI — I pinged Marigold sales lead to mention we prioritized the region for the launch. Min wants a short one-pager on launch support for renewal call.

kelly-cs: I'll assemble post-launch notes and latency dashboards for Mina. Will include token cost impact and tail-latency percentiles.

sam-infra: Final Q: Do we want to expose the temporary QPS bump as a dedicated rate-limit rule on their account, or use a global lift? Prefer per-customer rule so it's easy to revoke.

kelly-cs: Per-customer rule please. Label it marigold-launch-2024 and set auto-revoke timestamp.

javier-eng: Done. Rule added: account_rate_limit_override = 800 qps, id: rr-marigold-2024, auto_revoke=2024-06-13T06:00:00Z.

ops-bot: CHG-48291 status: staged -> scheduled. Route to oncall for the window.

kelly-cs: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll run the enablement call notes and confirm the test times with Marigold.

mina-am: Thanks everyone. If post-launch metrics look good I'll remove renewal from red to yellow.

alex-sales: Good luck on the launch — ping if anything breaks and I'll escalate with the customer. :rocket:
